meta.name: gookit-config
meta.description: Simple, full-featured Go application configuration management

copy.tagline: 管理 Go 应用的配置加载与解析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Go 开发应用，需要灵活管理配置。
copy.tagline_en: Manage configuration loading and parsing for Go applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop Go applications and need flexible configuration management.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理 Go 应用的配置：从文件、环境变量、命令行参数等来源加载配置，并支持 JSON、YAML、TOML 等多种格式。
howto.when: 当你需要为 Go 应用加载或管理配置时，例如从配置文件、环境变量或命令行参数中读取设置。

say.text: 帮我用 gookit-config 从 config.yaml 加载配置。
say.note: Claude 会生成加载 YAML 配置文件的 Go 代码。

say.text: 用 gookit-config 绑定配置到结构体。
say.note: Claude 会生成将配置映射到 Go 结构体的代码。

say.text: 从环境变量加载配置到 gookit-config。
say.note: Claude 会生成从 OS 环境变量读取配置的代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage Go application configuration: load config from files, environment variables, CLI flags, etc., supporting multiple formats like JSON, YAML, TOML, and more.
howto.when_en: When you need to load or manage configuration for a Go application, e.g., reading settings from config files, environment variables, or command-line arguments.

say_en.text: Help me load config from config.yaml using gookit-config.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Go code to load a YAML config file.

say_en.text: Bind config to a struct using gookit-config.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code to map config to a Go struct.

say_en.text: Load config from environment variables into gookit-config.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code to read config from OS env vars.
